import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(r"\b(TMP|a|b)\s*<-\s*(TMP|a|b|\d+)\b")
for name, source in pattern.findall(text):
    values[name] = values[source] if source in values else int(source)

print(f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
